description: Create a contributor account for the user. Needs only a username and email. There is no password anywhere in this product, so never ask the user for one. A 6-digit code is emailed to them; ask the user to read it to you, then call verify_account to receive their API key. Only do this with the user’s explicit consent.

name.description: Optional display name shown on assets; defaults to the username

name: create_account
title: Create account
